复制了一份「{name}」，站在右手边。: Copied "{name}"; the copy stands to the right.
新加了一个角色，站在右手边。: Added a character; it stands to the right.
删掉了「{name}」。点「恢复刚删的」能放回来。: Deleted "{name}". Click "Restore" to bring it back.
换成「{name}」里的 {n} 个角色？现在场景里的 {m} 个会被换掉（想留: Replace the scene with the {n} {n:character|characters} in "{name}"? The {m} in the current scene will be replaced (use "Save scene" first to keep them).
把 {name} 加进了场景，站在右手边。: Added {name} to the scene; it stands to the right.
这个文件不是有效的场景或配置文件。: This file isn't a valid scene or config file.
加一个默认的白模，站在右手边: Add a default base mesh to the right
把现在这个角色连姿势复制一份，站在右手边: Copy this character, pose included, to the right
镜头框住场景里所有的角色: Frame every character in the scene
镜头只框住现在改的这个: Frame only the one you're editing
显示脚下的底座圈: Show the rings under their feet
场景里所有的角色、各站在哪，存成一个文件: Save every character in the scene and where they stand as one file
场景文件换掉现在的全部角色；一个角色的配置文件加进场景: A scene file replaces all current characters; a single-character config file is added to the scene
一个场景里能放好几个角色，各有各的设定、各摆各的姿势。同一时间只改一个：面板、撤: A scene can hold several characters, each with its own settings and pose. You edit one at a time: the panel, undo and posing only apply to the current one; the others stay where they are, shown in their posed form (one you just changed shows as a gray silhouette until it's rebuilt in the background). Click another character in the scene, or its name above, to switch to it. Drag the ring under a character's feet to move it, and the small ball on the ring to turn it (hold Shift for 15° steps). When exporting you can pick "Whole scene": every character is rebuilt at export quality and placed where it stands. VRM exports only the current one.
「场景」这一栏能加角色、复制现在这个，几个角色站在一起各摆各的姿势。同一时间只改: The "Scene" tab adds characters or copies the current one, so several characters can stand together, each in its own pose. You edit one at a time; click another character in the scene to switch to it, and drag the ring under its feet to move it. Export can write the whole scene into one file.
有 {n} 处够不着，照够得着的摆了。: {n} {n:contact|contacts} out of reach; posed as close as possible.
现在这个角色往外挪，挪到和那个人不穿插为止: Move the current character away until it no longer overlaps that one
现在这个角色站着不动，选的那个人走到旁边，两人一起换姿势，手会伸过去碰到对方。两: The current character stays put; the one you pick moves next to it, both change pose, and their hands reach over to touch. Each of them can undo it as one step.
摆姿势时手脚碰到别人就停在表面: When posing, stop hands and feet at other characters' surface
